recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future rewrite of the Bundle introduction should be handled as a new work-group decision, not as remaining work for FHIR-5243.
issue_request: FHIR-5243 asked to clarify or remove the confusing DSTU1 Bundle section 6.8.1 sentence, "The resource bundle mostly includes the whole content of a resource." The issue is Published/Persuasive, and the accepted editor/work-group direction was to remove the sentence.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly names FHIR-5243. Git commit 368c9c3074eeb60fb30efdb8d319e75345501ebc removed the exact obsolete sentence from source/bundle/bundle-introduction.xml on 2015-01-30, and Jira later recorded the 2015-02-12 FHIR core telecon approval as edited/currently published.
additional_context: Bundle is active in source/fhir.ini, and the current source/bundle/bundle-introduction.xml describes Bundle scope and use cases without the removed "mostly includes" sentence. Searches found no related Jira issue beyond FHIR-5243 and no Zulip or Confluence record that changes the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch because the current authoritative source already implements the issue.
